cost.details: 1 Action per turret (Toolbelt special: 2 Actions + 1 scrap)

system.description:
1 Action. Activate one of your deployed turrets (its basic action). For 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap you can use its Toolbelt special instead; the turret is destroyed afterwards.

[A] Lists your live turrets and their actions; the chosen one runs from here — no need to open the turret's sheet. Your Actions are deducted (with an Undo card) after it resolves; a turret that has not fired since it was deployed fires for free.

[A] Using an action from the turret's own sheet costs the same.
